blockade.prompt: Inside a vast dark retro-futuristic containment vault at night, seen from the middle of a long gallery: rows of tall empty glowing glass stasis pods along both walls fading far into the distance, a polished dark floor, heavy gunmetal pillars and ceiling beams, thin neon magenta and cyan light strips along the walls, a cold blue haze far away, quiet and grand. No people, no creatures, no figures inside the pods, no text, no signs.
